headline: Spot Bitcoin Funds Shed $487 Million as Bitcoin Falls to 81k While Greed Holds Over a Flat Cycle
narrative: Spot bitcoin funds lost $487 million in the latest print, ether funds lost $161 million, and solana funds lost $4.8 million, while bitcoin trades near 81k after a 3.17% decline. Fear and greed reads 57, still labeled greed, while the cycle index sits flat at 56 in complacency, so sentiment is running ahead of the cash leaving the funds and the cycle score. Bitcoin funding is negative at -0.0015, a crowded-short print, the dollar is firm at 102.57, and volatility is quiet, with the VIX at 15.21 and seven-day realized volatility at 25.56% against 49.77% over thirty days, so the outflow is meeting shorts rather than a leverage chase or a volatility bid.
author: jordan
